games.name: The Intruder: Continuity
games.desc:
You're alone at home when the phone suddenly rings. A call from the Police Department warns you that a criminal is on the loose, and YOU are his next target. You rush to check the security cameras, scanning every corner for movement. He’s coming. The phone service is down, and you'll have to hide and survive until the phone signal returns.

🖥️ Controls:
Flashlight: [PC: F, Gamepad: Y]
Actions: [PC: E, F, Gamepad: X, Y]
Sprint (For Mineshaft & CN): [PC: Left-Shift, Gamepad: R2] 
Deep Breathe (For House & CN): [PC: Spacebar, Gamepad: RT]
Open Door (For House): [PC: Double Tap W, Gamepad: Double Tap LS]

NOTE: IF YOU REVIVE, YOU WON'T BE ABLE TO GET ANY BADGES IN THE CONCURRENT SESSION YOU ARE IN.
